product_metadata.title: Italian Luxury Body Pillow Cover - Soft 21" x 60" Microfiber Long Pillow Case w/ No Zipper - Fits 20" ﻿x 54" Pillow, Machine Washable, Burgundy
features: SUPER COMFORTABLE - Scratchy pillow cases are a thing of the past! Our superior body pillow pillowcase is not only made of soft microfibers, but the fabric is kind to your skin!
DURABLE - Our body pillow cover is stain, fade, and shrink resistant. Plus, the fabric stays wrinkle free, so you can go to bed pressed up against the smooth surface of a pillowcase.
GENTLE DESIGN - Forget about loose buttons or grating uncomfortable zippers! Our body pillow case cover is hotel quality and zipper free for a softer experience.
OVERSIZED - Our cooling pillow cases extend a full 6 inches beyond a 20" x 54" body pillow. The longer design is easy to put on, so you can spend less time sighing and more time snoozing!
MACHINE WASHABLE - Feel like your body pillow covers might be due for a wash? Just through it in the washing machine and tumble dry for a no-stress experience.
